item.title: GeoFS - Free Online Flight Simulator
item.description: GeoFS is a free flight simulator using global satellite images and running in your web browser or as a mobile app. Realistic and multiplayer, GeoFS provides real-life commercial traffic (ADS-B) and local weather conditions wherever you fly in the world.

item.title: GeoFS - Fly in Your Web Browser
item.description: Fly for free, directly in your web browser, without anything to download or to install.

item.title: GeoFS - Subscription plans
item.description: Free Legacy (2016) imagery set available for free in GeoFS. Theses global satellite images come from the Sentinel-2 (European Space Agency) Copernicus mission and provide a resolution between 10 and 60 meters per pixel. To compensate for the lack of precision, GeoFS overlays generic graphics for all runways longer than 5000 feet.
